select-basic: SELECT DISTINCT "employees"."id", "employees"."name", "salaries"."amount" FROM "employees" INNER JOIN "salaries" ON "employees"."id" = "salaries"."employee_id" WHERE "employees"."title" = :q1 AND "salaries"."amount" >= :q2 GROUP BY "employees"."id", "employees"."name" HAVING COUNT(salaries.id) > :q3 ORDER BY "employees"."hired_at" DESC LIMIT :q4 OFFSET :q5
